name: GL actuals by month (QuickBooks / Sage export, a column per month)
notes: The previous accounting system's 'Profit and loss by month' export: one row per plant, department and expense account with a column per month headed like 'Nov-25'. Month columns are unpivoted; accounts are classified into spend categories through the account mapping (their GL number → platform account → category). Accounts no category includes are reported, not guessed.
